exposure: Perinatal plasma atrial natriuretic peptide (ANP) levels
Perinatal plasma brain natriuretic peptide (BNP) levels
cohort: The study included 122 singleton neonates with congenital heart defects (CHDs) or arrhythmias and 27 healthy controls.
finding: Assessment of the umbilical artery (UA) plasma ANP level at birth and the cardiovascular profile (CVP) score in utero may be utilized to predict neonatal heart failure.
